title: Mexico E-Invoicing: A Practical Guide to CFDI 4.0 Rules
summary: Mexico e-invoicing explained: how CFDI 4.0 works, what a PAC does, setup steps, complements, cancellations and penalties for getting it wrong.

**Ingreso (I)**


Income from selling goods or services


At the time of the sale


Comercio Exterior (goods exports); Carta Porte (freight services)


**Egreso (E)**


Credit notes for returns, discounts, and refunds


When the value of an earlier sale goes down


Comercio Exterior (adjustments to exports)


**Traslado (T)**


Movement of goods without a sale


Before goods move


Carta Porte; Comercio Exterior (some export cases)


**Nómina (N)**


Wages and salaries


On each pay date


Nómina (required)


**Pago (P)**


Payments received on PPD invoices


By the fifth calendar day of the following month


Recepción de Pagos 2.0 (required)
